title: Closing the Loop: Resource-aware Hybrid NAS Guided by Analytical and Hardware-Calibrated Quantum Cost Modeling
summary: Hybrid quantum-classical neural networks (HQNNs) integrate quantum circuits with classical layers, each operating under fundamentally different computational paradigms, which makes hardware resource estimation challenging. The training of quantum circuits on real devices requires thousands of circuit executions, which is impractical on current NISQ devices. Therefore, most HQNNs are evaluated on classical simulators, with hardware cost approximated using floating-point operations (FLOPs).
